record.one_liner: Netlify is a cloud platform for building, deploying and hosting web sites and apps, with builds, serverless functions, forms, DNS and CDN.
record.auth_notes: Personal access tokens (Applications > Personal access tokens) are sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'. OAuth2 is documented for public integrations: register an application for a client key and secret; the user authorization endpoint is https://app.netlify.com/authorize. The OpenAPI spec also shows a ticket-based flow (POST /oauth/tickets, then exchange). SAML SSO teams need an opt-in when the PAT is generated. Resetting the account password invalidates all PATs and OAuth tokens.
record.access_notes: Any Netlify account can create a PAT or register an OAuth app. The fetched pages do not state which plans include API access, and I did not verify that the free plan does. Inferred from the docs showing no plan gating. Deploys via the API are limited to 3/min and 100/day.
record.blocker: none. Caveat: rate limits are 500 requests/min, and API deploys are limited to 3/min and 100/day. No scope model is documented, so a token has the full access of its owner.
